dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Serrated, high-intensity perimeters forming irregular 'O' and 'C' motifs; sharp gradient transition from light-grey outer boundaries to darker-grey interior voids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of asymmetrical, high-intensity pixel clusters localized along the central dorsal-lateral axis; core concentrations exhibit minimal internal gradient and appear as solid white-grey patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a series of four smaller high-intensity blobs are arranged in a roughly linear trajectory along the caudal-lateral section.
